name: Lee Kong Chian
tagline: The cattle boy from Furong who became the Rubber and Pineapple King, then kept his name off what he gave.

cloth.why: Smoked-rubber brown: the colour of the sheets in his Muar smoke-house. Most of the life (1893-1941) falls in the colonial era; it would sit beside eraFor()'s colonial accent #9a3c1c, mixed toward the ink.
